name: Leila
html: Originally from Iran, Leila spent most of her life in Dubai managing her own business and accounting for her excellent familiarity of Dubai’s beautiful terrain. Leila Graduated from University of Art , prides herself on giving her clients the best service possible, which she believes is to offer a friendly, professional, honest and informative service. As a specialist in Palm Jumeirah, Burj Khalifa Tower . Leila will go above and beyond to guide buyers and sellers through the processes involved, offering a no-nonsense approach and providing excellent customer service.

name: Naghmeh
html: Naghmeh has a high level of motivation, efficiency, drive for success, customer service skills and the ability to meet any objectives. Naghmeh is all about her client’s needs, whether you are looking to buy or sell your property Claudia will be able to guide you from start to finish and make any sales process stress free and simple for all clients. Naghmeh believes anything in life is possible with a positive attitude.

name: Jeffrey Gullbrand
html:
Jeffrey was born and raised in Sweden, most notably Gothenburg and Stockholm, before making the move to Dubai in 2004 and joining Prestige at end of 2015, although Jeffrey has been working closely with Prestige since his move to Dubai.

His greatest achievement has been the friendships he has built with clients he has served – it shows they were pleased with his service and that his clients have made the right choice by investing through him. Other notable achievements include continued top performer awards since 2004 in real estate brokerages consisting of hundreds of agents and being the consultant that has sold the most units in Le Reve, the most luxurious tower of its time.

Jeffrey’s guiding principle is his ethics and always doing the right thing, this along with his core strengths of his professionalism, continued high standards and customer service of which his priority is helping his clients achieve their objectives.

name: Barry Gale
html:
Mr. Barry Gale have been in real estate in his entire working career, and a truly passionate about this field. He started in one of London’s leading real estate companies, Savills, focusing with clientele from the most prestigious areas in London and worked his way through to management level.

His major role in France was more than just a real estate broker but doing his best by going the extra mile in getting the property that his clients require through networking and good old fashion hard work with integrity and charisma, pushing outstanding customer service skills to a first class level.

name: Alireza Javid
html:
Reliable, credible and knowledgeable are a few of the words most often attributed to Ali Reza by clients and colleagues alike. He understands his clients’ needs and assists them from the time they are searching for the most suitable properties, up until the properties they have chosen are in their possession.

He has successfully sold over two hundred off-plan Dubai properties from Tehran, Iran from where he originates, catapulting him to the position of Sales Manager in the company he worked for in his home country. Succeeding in selling Dubai properties from offshore, he decided to move to Dubai itself at the inception of the Real Estate Market in the U. A. E.

Since joining Prestige, Ali has built a reputation on reliability, honesty and integrity. With continued repeat business over the years and a hunger to continue improving, Ali remains a key member of the Prestige family.

name: Owen M. Bulpett
html:
Owen was Born in Winchester, Hampshire. After finishing his college education, he began his 19 year-long Real Estate Career working within a rural independent company. His passion for all things property grew and developed earning him a degree in Landscape design and working in London Athens and the Greek islands.

In recent years whilst successfully running his own company as a property developer renovating and building properties across the UK and Europe at the same time as studying towards a Property Surveyor Bcs (ongoing) with the aim of gaining the Royal Institute of Chartered Surveyors accreditation. Owen moved to Dubai to expand the passion for Real Estate and return to the floor with his two decades of experience.

name: Jeong Hwa Lee
html:
Jay Lee is one of the client managers of Prestige Real Estate established in Dubai’s Real Estate industry for twelve years. She manages the properties at the same time her Korean team to grow their personal and professional brands. After four years of full dedication in the work field of buying, leasing and investing in both residential and commercial properties, she has grown great connections and trusted by known corporate companies.

As an experienced real estate agent, she has managed to specialize in several areas in Dubai such as Dubai Marina and Emirates Living. She knows what truly the market demands and keeps herself updated with all new trend the market may offer to lead to a complete assistance for her valued clients.

An eligible senior property consultant, Ms. Jay Lee certainly renders her full service in leasing and selling businesses for all her clients.

name: John Samuel Dionio
html:
Highly driven and always seeking the edge over competitors, John is a passionate real estate professional. This ensures he provides clients with six-star customer service with unrivaled energy, negotiation skills and passion for the Dubai market. John was drawn to the professionalism of Prestige Real Estate and the clean brand it presents.

His determination and high standards are directly aligned with the Prestige Real Estate values of commitment to client relationships and achieving optimum results.

Company Profile: Prestige Real Estate is a family owned brokerage which has been an established provider of residential and commercial properties in the UAE since 2006.

name: Tony Ojong Asu
html:
Tony is a Reliable Real Estate specialist with huge experience who has prepped himself in the real estate business – selling & renting properties. He is from Nigeria, speaks fluent English and French. He also has a legal background on property transactions especially.

With this portfolio, you can trust him to handle all your transactions in a professional and ethical manner. He definitely cares about his clients and their feedback. At present, he is working in an award-winning real estate organization in Dubai. He specializes in Marina Dubai, JBR and Bluewaters Island.

name: Arvinder
html: Reliable, credible and knowledgeable are a few of the words most often attributed to Arvinder by clients and colleagues alike. He understands his clients’ needs and assists them from the time they are searching for the most suitable properties, up until the properties they have chosen are in their possession.

name: Akhtar Hussain
html:
Committed to achieving success in the real estate industry, Akhtar is an accomplished property consultant. Energetic and enthusiastic, Akhtar enjoys meeting new people and thrives on being able to build long-term client relationships.

His high attention to detail and ability to think outside of the box means that his clients will benefit from his assistance. He is always striving to go the extra mile in order to succeed. Service means everything to Akhtar and he has a strong determination to deliver not only great results but an exceptional and rewarding experience. With an outstanding caliber of client care and flawless follow through, he is an honest professional who is eager to devote his skills and abilities to his clients. Akhtar understands the importance of making a great first impression and always endeavors to provide first class service.

name: James Ismaila Kuram
html:
Kuram James has 2 years experience in the Real Estate industry . He is always very dedicated and focused at his work, a person with high integrity who always goes the extra mile for his clients with exceptional customer service.

He has a strong knowledge in Dubai Rental Law and very familiar with the rental & sales procedures, also investment advisor skills. James is good at problem solving and understanding of customers needs. He has a Very Good Knowledge of Dubai Marina. Always to Ready to Serve & Give the best service to his clients.

name: Kyriaki Sfyrikla
html:
Displaying a high attention to detail and supreme organizational efficiency, Kyriaki enjoys the challenges of her role and the opportunity to meet new and interesting people.

Kyriaki’s nature ensures she will go above and beyond her position to consistently achieve excellent customer service. She strives to continually upgrade her property management skills and always looks for ways to not only perform her role but to solve problems and surpass expectations.

name: Anusha Bhowan
html:
With her strong ethics, great communication skills and extended knowledge of the Dubai market, Anusha is an experienced consultant at Prestige. With a background in Psychology, she is very understanding of her clients and provides a very personalized service.

Known as one of the top agents in the market, Anusha specializes in the Greens & the Views. She possesses an extended knowledge of the area and would be happy to assist you with finding your new home or renting/selling your property. As Anusha says ‘ she is a very competitive Brit who works very hard and fair and she will go out her way to her best ability to make sure her clients are looked after’.

Anusha is great at building trustful relationships with her clients from offering great advice to making sure the client is well settled in his/her new home.

If you are a landlord looking to rent/sell or expand your portfolio, Anusha has a great network of clients and agents in the market and she will be able to assist you.

name: Norlisha Binte Abdullah
html:
Honesty, transparency, empathy and professionalism, that’s Lisha Holland’s pledge to each of her clients. Lisha moved to Dubai to begin her career in sales.

With a career track record in the real estate industry, she has set an impressive record of successful transactions. She has a business and customer-oriented understanding of what clients’ needs and expect. Constantly aware of each client’s individual needs, Lisha is committed to providing outstanding service and honest feedback to ensure a first-rate result.

For the skills experience and personal advice you need from a seasoned consultant, in any aspects of sales and leasing, or simply making a lifetime investment in JBR and Non-Freehold Villas, Lisha commits and delivers.

name: Carolina Gildemeister Ducato
html:
Born in Lima, Peru, Carolina moved to Dubai and used to work as an engineer in food technology for many years. After seeing an opportunity in the Dubai Real Estate market, she decided to changed her career path.

Every transaction, she believes, it’s always about her customer. The key to Carolina’s success has also been the result of her patient demeanor and dedicated work ethic. She knows how to listen, is generous in offering information. Her main intention is to understand her client’s needs and build a relationship that will last over the course of time. She loves traveling and photography.

name: Jessica Horie
html:
Jessica Horie is an active and adventurous sales professional. Being raised in one of the most beautiful and robust areas of Canada, she has grown up with skiing and whitewater rafting and was a back country ski guide prior to landing in real estate in 2006. With the continuous annual top performance reported, she confidently made the jump to Dubai in 2011 to drive her career in real estate to a higher level.

She is recognized by the Dubai Land Department as the top performing real estate agent in Dubai and is one of the key members of the Prestige Real Estate family.
